verdict.rationale: Aleph is a SaaS FP&A platform, so versioned public APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. "Versioned forecasts" refers to financial-model versioning, and "anything with an API" refers to inbound connectors, so neither is relevant to this story.
